"""Bounded original-log review, not a control rerun or study acceptance."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

ROOT = Path('/workspace/scratch/bfccb8494ba0')
OUT = ROOT / 'round35-PR192-original-CI-intake'
LOG = OUT / '113947021336-original-main.log'
HEAD = 'e7f8e913861f32e6745bcd56794601133b621c34'
MERGE = 'ce4a9cf641f311a3f7b2c80fbac55499effd1078'
NAMES = ['isolated_fanout_retains_actual_initial_and_final_tables_without_a_scale_corpus',
         'isolated_profile_wire_cannot_select_another_protocol_or_omit_its_identity',
         'isolated_fresh_batch_keeps_original_target_and_both_full_parity_checkpoints']

def identity(p):
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {'local_path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(b)).encode() + b'\0' + b).hexdigest()}

raw = LOG.read_bytes()
assert len(raw) == 1084801 and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == '2e3c04a96474c356bcd9c93ba0a0a9889898ba614d654ad2cfe6ec94aba5d96b'
assert identity(LOG)['git_blob'] == '76591d60dca0c3e3039840521089071c69f2a177'
lines = raw.decode().splitlines()
clean = [re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', s) for s in lines]
source_raw = json.loads((OUT / 'source-merge-and-head-official-originals.json').read_text())
sources = [json.loads(r['value']['structuredContent']['content']) for r in source_raw]
merge, head = sources
assert merge['sha'] == MERGE and head['sha'] == HEAD
assert merge['tree']['sha'] == head['tree']['sha'] == '23d1452142cdba45fd2c00c5bd216e0fefee0a3d'
assert [p['sha'] for p in merge['parents']] == ['10ec828beb94200ec679302c45115760ebd55ee9', HEAD]
checkout_line = next(i for i, s in enumerate(clean) if s.endswith(' ' + MERGE))
assert 'git log -1 --format=%H' in clean[checkout_line - 1]
blocks = []
for i, line in enumerate(clean):
    if 'Running tests/p8_scale.rs (' not in line:
        continue
    end = next(j for j in range(i + 1, len(clean)) if 'test result:' in clean[j])
    matches = re.search(r'(\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out', clean[end])
    counts = dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered'), map(int, matches.groups())))
    group = max(j for j in range(i) if '##[group]Run ' in clean[j])
    named = {name: [{'line': j + 1, 'text': lines[j]} for j in range(i, end + 1)
                     if 'test ' + name + ' ... ok' in clean[j]] for name in NAMES}
    blocks.append({'run_line': i + 1, 'run_text': lines[i], 'result_line': end + 1, 'result_text': lines[end],
                   'counts': counts, 'command_group_line': group + 1, 'command_group': clean[group], 'named_controls': named})
assert len(blocks) == 3
passing = [x for x in blocks if x['counts']['passed'] == 17]
filtered = [x for x in blocks if x['counts']['passed'] == 0]
assert len(passing) == 2 and len(filtered) == 1
assert all(x['counts'] == {'passed': 17, 'failed': 0, 'ignored': 0, 'measured': 0, 'filtered': 0} for x in passing)
assert all(len(x['named_controls'][n]) == 1 for x in passing for n in NAMES)
assert filtered[0]['counts'] == {'passed': 0, 'failed': 0, 'ignored': 0, 'measured': 0, 'filtered': 17}
admission_line = next(i for i, s in enumerate(clean) if '{"schema_version": 10, "source_version": "p8-completion-source-20261009-v15"' in s)
admission = json.loads(clean[admission_line][clean[admission_line].index('{'):])
assert admission['status'] == 'passed' and admission['complete_inputs'] == 1095
assert admission['product_source'] == '8b71a5bf3578f7faed39ce219e3ac75053ce71ed'
assert admission['review_source'] == 'dd90fd1c6576e1916a585c692bbccb47046ae03b'
control181 = next(i for i, s in enumerate(clean) if 'Ran 181 tests in ' in s)
assert any(s.endswith(' OK') for s in clean[control181 + 1:control181 + 5])
report = {'schema': 'PR192-original-main-log-bounded-followup-review-v1',
    'recorded_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Update stale queued/native-controls-pending metadata with original ordinary CI evidence only.',
    'original_log': identity(LOG), 'log_transport_owner': 'root; no additional download by this reviewer',
    'ordinary_run': 37967969818, 'attempt': 1, 'job': 113947021336,
    'source_bridge': {'PR_head': HEAD, 'actual_checkout': MERGE, 'checkout_line': checkout_line + 1,
        'checkout_stdout': lines[checkout_line], 'ordered_merge_parents': [p['sha'] for p in merge['parents']],
        'whole_tree': merge['tree']['sha'], 'whole_tree_equals_fixed_head': True,
        'official_objects': identity(OUT / 'source-merge-and-head-official-originals.json')},
    'three_named_native_controls': NAMES, 'unique_controls': 3,
    'actual_observed_successes_per_control': 2, 'target_blocks': blocks,
    'filtered_block_credit': '0 executed controls; all17 filtered, retained separately',
    'original_admission': {'line': admission_line + 1, 'record': admission},
    'original_181_controls': {'line': control181 + 1, 'summary': lines[control181], 'status': 'OK'},
    'ordinary_job_terminal_status_reference': 'Prior official fixed-head checks/jobs observation: completed success at2026-10-09T18:50:52Z.',
    'limitations': ['These are ordinary engineering controls, not registered1350-slot measurement output.',
        'The fresh-history study remains untriggered; no sample or TODO credit.',
        'The log tests the historical merge whose whole tree equals fixed head e7f8. No credit transferred to a later source or current main.',
        'This report supplies metadata/evidence correction only, not merge or integration approval.'],
    'review_actions': {'network_log_downloads': 0, 'product_or_test_execution': 0, 'guard_rerun': 0,
        'GitHub_small_commit_GETs': 2, 'refs_or_labels_or_dispatch': 0}}
with (OUT / 'bounded-original-main-log-review.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'verdict': 'accepted_scoped_original_ordinary_CI_evidence', 'controls': 3,
    'actual_successes_each': 2, 'whole_tree_equals_head': True, 'report': identity(OUT / 'bounded-original-main-log-review.json')}))

scope: Read-only original-log parsing and two small official source-object reads, not product execution.
